build_subword_nmt_bpe_encoder: build a SubwordNMTBPE encoder using bpe codes file and separator to apply BPE tokenization
encode_text_with_bpe: encode a string using the SubwordNMTBPE encode method to apply BPE subword segmentation
decode_bpe_tokenized_text: decode BPE tokenized text by removing the bpe separator symbol using the decode method
add_bpe_args_to_parser: add bpe-codes and bpe-separator arguments to an argparse parser using the add_args static method
review_subword_nmt_bpe_class: review the SubwordNMTBPE class and its encode decode methods for BPE subword tokenization
